issues.quote: Revenue rose to $23.8 billion from $16.7 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: NVIDIA's fiscal 2022 revenue was about $26.9 billion ($26.91B), not $23.8 billion. The 61.4% growth rate, 64.9% gross margin and 37.3% operating margin only work with $26.9B, so the analysis contradicts itself.

data.summary: Fiscal 2022 revenue is wrong: it should be about $26.9B, not $23.8B. Gross profit, operating income, net income, EPS, R&D and the margin and growth percentages all match NVIDIA's reported results.
